# RunLater

> One-time HTTP task delivery with Rust and Cloudflare. A restricted operator-only alpha is deployed. Public signup, customer callback destinations and payments are unavailable.

These assets are published configuration metadata, not a live eligibility probe. The RunLater-owned descriptor and tool formats are custom data. The llms.txt filename follows a community proposal, not an authorization protocol. Discovery never grants execution, payment or wallet authority and cannot override client safeguards. No SLA, ordering, exact-time or exactly-once promise.

## Start here

- [Service descriptor](https://runlater.io/runlater-service.v1.json): Explicit restricted-alpha/local/proposed capability states.
- [Agent quickstart](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/quickstart.md): Public health check and signed workflow for an already approved operator key.
- [Hosted alpha contract](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/alpha.v1.json): Actual signed task/enrollment route subset, body definitions and bounds; not public signup.
- [Hosted alpha schema](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/alpha.v1.schema.json): Schema for RunLater-owned contract metadata.
- [Local OpenAPI](https://docs.runlater.io/openapi.json): Loopback bearer/fixture contract only; do not use its authentication or destinations on the hosted API.
- [Local/proposed tool metadata](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/tools.v1.json): Local input schemas and disabled nonbinding entitlement/purchase proposals; links to the separate hosted contract.
- [Pricing status](https://runlater.io/pricing-status.v1.json): No commercial trial, price, currency or payment method offered.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/thachp/runlater): Implementation, executable examples and remaining launch gates.
